\/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 54 year old male patient came to medicine OPD with chief complaints Of\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1) Fever since five days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2) SOB since five days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3) Vomiting since three days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of presenting illness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently Intermatic five days back then he developed fever, which is of high grade associated with chills and rigors and not relieved on medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen he had SOB since five days grade 3, There is no history of orthopnea And paroxysmal Nocturnal dyspnoea\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe also had 2-3 episodes of vomiting since three days which are non-bilious , non-blood stain and watery.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is no history of cough\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o Loose and glimiperide 1mg BD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is a K\/C\/O HTN Since 20 years and on amlodipine, 50mg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe had a ulcer on the left foot since four months which is associated with idiom of the food and there is a history of abscess drainage\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is a new bleb visible since two days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/K\/C\/O asthma,epilepsy,CAD and CVA\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe’s a vegetarian since childhood\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDecreased appetite\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder movements are regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep is adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo Addictions\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo
